title: Add stable Tensor overloads for index_select, floor_divide, and is_pinned (2.14+)
body:
## Summary
- Add `torch::stable::{index_select,floor_divide,is_pinned}` Tensor–Tensor wrappers (gated at 2.14) via `torch_call_dispatcher`
- Document the new APIs in the stable operators docs
- Cover them in the 2.14 libtorch-agnostic extension tests

'stacked' on top of:
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/192083
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/191973
Will need to rebase once those are merged. 

see commits https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/192097/changes/c4e0c5c1ef85bb93cd0d6e3cc46cff6446222db7..cb760bb831420502c80f49fa7881c6050a029807 for new edits in this PR
 
## Test plan
- [x] `python -m pytest test/cpp_extensions/test_libtorch_agnostic.py -k 'test_my_index_select or test_my_floor_divide or test_my_is_pinned' -v`


cc @janeyx99
